Question: Is it true (answer with True or False) that the exceedance rate of fresh water beaches follow the same trend as the rainfall, from 2020 to 2023 (inclusive)? (e.g., they both increase and decrease together) Impute missing values with median of the month in non-missing years.

def process(water_tests, precip_all) -> pd.DataFrame:
    months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec']
    # --- water tests: fresh beaches, 2020-2023, compute annual exceedance rate (violations / total samples)
    w = water_tests
    w = w[w['Beach Type Description'].str.lower() == 'fresh']
    w = w[w['Year'].between(2020, 2023)]
    v = w['Violation'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    viol = v.isin(['yes','y','true','1'])
    exceed = w.assign(is_violation=viol).groupby('Year', as_index=True).agg(total_samples=('is_violation','size'), violations=('is_violation','sum'))
    exceed['exceedance_rate'] = exceed['violations'] / exceed['total_samples']
    exceed = exceed.reset_index()[['Year','exceedance_rate']]
    # --- precipitation: clean, impute month medians using all numeric years, then compute annual and mean annual per year
    p = precip_all.copy()
    p['Year_num'] = pd.to_numeric(p['Year'], errors='coerce')
    p_num = p[~p['Year_num'].isna()].copy()
    p_num['Year_num'] = p_num['Year_num'].astype(int)
    for m in months:
        p_num[m] = pd.to_numeric(p_num[m], errors='coerce')
    medians = p_num[months].median()
    p_num[months] = p_num[months].fillna(medians)
    p_num['annual_calc'] = p_num[months].sum(axis=1)
    # compute mean annual rainfall across rows (stations) for each year
    rain = p_num.groupby('Year_num', as_index=True).agg(mean_annual=('annual_calc','mean')).reset_index().rename(columns={'Year_num':'Year'})
    rain = rain[rain['Year'].between(2020,2023)]
    # merge
    df = pd.DataFrame({'Year': [2020,2021,2022,2023]})
    df = df.merge(exceed, on='Year', how='left').merge(rain, on='Year', how='left')
    # forward/backfill if any missing rates/values? keep as is
    # compute year-to-year signs
    df = df.sort_values('Year').reset_index(drop=True)
    df['delta_exceed'] = df['exceedance_rate'].diff()
    df['delta_rain'] = df['mean_annual'].diff()
    df['sign_exceed'] = df['delta_exceed'].apply(lambda x: 0 if pd.isna(x) else (1 if x>0 else (-1 if x<0 else 0)))
    df['sign_rain'] = df['delta_rain'].apply(lambda x: 0 if pd.isna(x) else (1 if x>0 else (-1 if x<0 else 0)))
    # compare signs for sequential changes (2020->2021, 21->22, 22->23)
    signs_match = (df['sign_exceed'].iloc[1:].reset_index(drop=True) == df['sign_rain'].iloc[1:].reset_index(drop=True)).all()
    out = df[['Year','exceedance_rate','mean_annual','delta_exceed','delta_rain','sign_exceed','sign_rain']]
    out['same_trend'] = signs_match
    return out
input.summary: Compare yearly exceedance rate for Fresh beaches (proportion of samples with Violation in ['yes','y','true','1']) for years 2020-2023 to mean annual precipitation. For precipitation: keep rows with numeric Year, convert months to numeric, impute missing month values with the month's median across non-missing years, compute annual as sum of months, then take mean annual precipitation per year. Return per-year exceedance_rate and mean_annual and whether year-to-year change signs match for all consecutive steps (same_trend boolean).
